engine_contract.hard_optimization_gate: incremental and accumulated sampled Jacobians only
engine_contract.integration_check: bidirectional interior p99 inverse error with at least 95 percent valid coverage
engine_contract.controllers: objective damping, geometry step scale, and integration depth are independent
engine_contract.export: separate admission boundary; inverse tolerance and endpoint topology return typed failures

production_derivative_oracle.epsilon_policy: physical step ladder scaled by the minimum voxel size

synthetic_capture.fixture: deterministic asymmetric multi-blob and low-amplitude textured scalar field
synthetic_capture.required_gate: 2mm and 4mm endpoint RMS reduction at least 80 percent, objective improvement, and zero folds in authoritative midpoint arms
synthetic_capture.capture_range_finding: without a coarse proposal, 8mm and 12mm improve but remain outside the accuracy gate

support_contract.trial_support: frozen between current and candidate objective evaluations
support_contract.boundary: partial-window CC over a one-step sampling-safe FoV erosion with soft Gaussian weights

failure_attribution.metric: production derivative oracle passed; accepted steps monotonically reduce the frozen trial objective
failure_attribution.sampling: one-step sampling-safe support removes the zero-step boundary discontinuity found during G4
failure_attribution.topology: authoritative midpoint arms remain fold-free; endpoint export topology is independently admitted or rejected
failure_attribution.integration: interior p99 and minimum-valid-coverage checks admit paired increments without using accumulated inverse drift as an anatomical rejection
failure_attribution.support: active and edge support remain available through partial CC windows; held-out moving masks have no objective path
failure_attribution.inversion: 2mm export is admitted; 4mm, 8mm, and 12mm exports return typed endpoint-topology failures rather than unsafe maps

limitations: The current no-proposal local engine does not have an adequate 8mm or 12mm capture range.
The sampled residual inverse/export algorithm admits the 2mm lane but returns a typed topology failure for 4mm and larger lanes.
The 4mm authoritative midpoint state passes the accuracy and topology gate even though its sampled inverse-pair export is not admissible.
No labeled-cohort or ANTs-parity claim follows from this synthetic correctness gate.
The portable production implementation remains longer than the eventual compact API target and has not yet been performance-profiled as a complete engine.
